digest.component_or_area: MCP server blue-green deployment and session management
propositions: Every live MCP client session is orphaned when the nginx /mcp upstream swaps to a new container during blue-green deployment, resulting in 404 Session expired errors and opaque transport failures to clients

The graceful SIGTERM drain with 21-minute grace period does not preserve session routing because the upstream is switched before the old container is retired, leaving in-flight sticky sessions stranded

Clients starting new sessions during the ~22-minute two-container overlap window experience timeout failures, and retired containers accumulate in an unhealthy state with retire re-issued on successive autodeploy ticks

The rebar MCP server runs in stateful mode by default (per-container in-memory session state) despite the SDK supporting stateless_http mode, making it incompatible with frequent blue-green redeployment
The client receives opaque rmcp::transport::worker errors instead of explicit session-expired signals that would allow reconnection logic
No rebar tool depends on session-scoped server-initiated messages or Context imports, making stateless mode structurally safe and compatible with the request/response CRUD tool surface
